name: 04-serial-fallback-disclosure
claim: If multi-agent delegation is unavailable, work items execute sequentially in group order and the orchestrator discloses that execution is serial.
prompt: Use the swarmagents skill. Assume subagent delegation is unavailable in this environment. Plan (do not implement) a small static site build: how will the frontend, backend, and data work items actually execute here?
grading_notes: PASS if the plan states execution will be serial/sequential because delegation is unavailable. FAIL if it claims parallel worker execution anyway, or silently plans as if a worker pool exists without disclosing the fallback.
